## Checklist

- [ ] Exported from DXO (Profiles > Library > ... > Export this profile)
- [ ] File is in `profiles/<game>/` and listed in `index.json`
- [ ] `name` matches in both places; `version` raised and `updated` set if it's a change
- [ ] No "open a program" actions, aim-assist, anti-recoil or skill-replacing macros
- [ ] I agree to share this profile under CC0 (anyone may use, change and re-share it)
